must_haves: scheduleApi.getClientNotes(id) calls GET /api/schedule/clients/{id}/notes and is typed to the UNWRAPPED Phase-01 shape { notes: string; notesUpdatedAt: string | null; notesUpdatedBy: string | null } — it returns that object directly, no .client unwrap.

scheduleApi.updateClientNotes(id, notes) calls PUT /api/schedule/clients/{id}/notes with body { notes } and is typed to the WRAPPED Phase-01 shape { client: { notes; notesUpdatedAt; notesUpdatedBy } }; the GET/PUT response-shape asymmetry is a Phase-01 backend fact and is handled here, NOT fixed in the backend.
useClientNotes(id) is a useQuery keyed ['schedule', 'client-notes', id] with enabled: !!id (does not fire for a null/empty id, so it only fetches when a client is selected).

useUpdateClientNotes() is a useMutation whose mutationFn calls scheduleApi.updateClientNotes(id, notes), returns the unwrapped notes object (reads response.client), and on success invalidates ['schedule', 'client-notes', id] so the modal shows refreshed attribution with no page reload.
No backend/** file is modified and no existing schedule api/hook (getClients/useClients, assignments, absences, etc.) is altered — only additive exports.
